notes.title: Demo Update Version 0.1.0.2
notes.notes:
Updated since previous version (0.1.0.1):
	- Added new music

	- Improved UI

	- Turn summary pops up every turn

	- Added a name display to every building

	- Characters now indicate when they are ready for a breakthrough

	- Changed the skills to numbered levels instead of confusing wording



Thank you for playing!

— Alena & Anna
